title: S3 Production Environment & CDE Governance
purpose: Govern the internal production ecosystem, CDE platform authority, collaboration boundaries, output handling, and procedural interfaces to S2, S5, S7, S8, and the CDE implementation branch.

requirements.statement: ACC Docs shall serve as the primary governed internal cloud environment for TIVERIT project collaboration and information-container management, subject to project contractual precedence.
Authoring tools are authoritative only within their declared scope; governed reliance begins only when information is placed in the appropriate governed platform/container.
Software versions are project-governed through the BEP; enterprise standards govern tool roles and authority boundaries rather than fixed releases.
Monitoring tools, scripts, and automation do not create authority, grant approval, or confer legal reliance.
Informal collaboration, chat, markup, and visibility do not constitute approval or acceptance.
Working outputs and formally issued deliverables shall remain distinct; formal exchange must bind to S2 information requirements and permitted-use constraints.
S1 overrules S3 on organizational authority, S2 overrules S3 on information requirements, and CDE procedural execution is delegated to governed implementation workflows.
S3 governs the internal production ecosystem and shall not assert authority over external consultant systems, client environments, or contractual liabilities beyond project-defined interfaces.
The existence, availability, or visual completeness of a production output shall not by itself make that output a deliverable or authorize reliance on it.
Production outputs intended for governed use shall have an explicitly declared maturity or information state appropriate to their purpose; apparent detail shall not substitute for that declaration.
The communication channel used for collaboration shall not alter the governance status, authority, or permitted use of the information communicated.
Uploading, downloading, synchronizing, linking, attaching, or otherwise moving information within or between production systems shall not by itself constitute formal delivery or transfer authority.

provenance.migration_note: Canonical S3 parent assembled from the source production-environment doctrine and enriched with explicit collaboration, output-maturity, and transmission boundaries.
